hook: My idea-to-post routine, in five steps
caption: A simple routine keeps posting steady: one idea, a draft, an edit, a native format per platform, then a scheduled slot.
cta: Which step slows you down most?
beats: Step one: write the idea in one sentence.
Step two: get a first draft.
Step three: edit it. Cut claims with no source.
Step four: shape it for each platform.
Which step slows you down most?
